items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: See, I mentioned that to Roy Haynes during the night he almost fell off the stage. I said 'man do you realize how long I've been knowing you-all my life, you funny looking dude!'

ctx.x: I mean there was a whole bunch of cats. I mean they could really play, man.

That's right. See, I mentioned that to Roy Haynes during the night he almost fell off the stage. I said 'man do you realize how long I've been knowing you-all my life, you funny looking dude!' I said 'when I saw you, you were in Louis Russell's band'. He almost fell off the stool.
